theorems.name: Submission.dtc_cwv_action_dilation_invariant
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ β γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (n : ℝ) • (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y + fderiv ℝ (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y y) → R.action (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = 0) → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (lam⁻¹ • y)) → R.action (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)
